entries.statement: wrist_flex error grows from 0.2 to 5 degrees after lift or goto starts and the guard then cuts torque; stopped 12 sessions on 10/25-27.
Extended over the conveyor the wrist sags about 2 units at rest, so waiting on a fixed delay crawls; hold only while the delay is shrinking.
The arm own error going down is about 2.7 mm horizontally, not the main cause of misses by position.
A runner that dies on a tick exception now writes a fault line first; no status line means a 300 s wait.
With no command for 3 minutes the arm parks, 3 more minutes at home ends the session with torque off.
The planner joint4 limit (106.6 deg) blocks a far vertical descent; the Pinky plate centre is out of reach for a 4 cm approach, 2 cm works to 0.21 m.
The nightly reboot once rebooted the Fleet PC mid-move; it now skips while the session lock is held, but this is not applied on the Fleet PC yet.
After a reboot the gripper camera preview shows no fresh frame until its user service is restarted.
Top camera frame noise of about 200 px is gone after a 3x3 opening; a stop is under 40 px after opening.
Closing the jaws to the mechanical end twists the extended wrist and shifts the arm between photos; close only to 50.5.
The part that changes when the jaws move is a joint about 29 mm beside the TCP, so a map made at one yaw shifts at another (44 mm for 96.5 deg).
Jaw closing direction is yaw + 90 deg with a wrist-origin error within about 7 deg; being confirmed by a pivot measurement.
The gripper camera looks obliquely forward, not down, so it cannot judge alignment directly.
Leave-one-out map error: Pinky plate mean 3.95 mm (max 8.76), container area mean 5.8 mm (max 11.4), without the jaw-offset correction.
Near the lower screen edge the jaws leave the view and cannot be marked; work from the upper container as the user directed.
Green containers are 30 mm square in section, 30/60/90 mm long, top about 0.036 m above the floor.
Catalogue matching split touching 2- and 3-cell containers and dropped a 22x13 fragment, but two touching 1-cell containers look like one 2-cell.
Corrected true centres are about (-87.9, 206.1) mm for the 3-cell and (-57.5, 230.9) mm for the 2-cell container.
Measurement decides first and the model only picks among what is left; touching or unlisted objects are not grasped.
Watch 55 C and 80% PWM, never cut torque mid-move (fold home, then off), idle ends at home with torque off, minimise motor strain.
Prefer solving it with cameras and measurement without a person hand, and run the simulator in parallel.
